parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time between refreshing the data in hours (minimum 1 hour, maximum 48 hours).

parameter.name: liveRefreshInterval
parameter.label: Live Data Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time between refreshing live consumption data in seconds (requires Home Mini). Minimum 60 seconds, maximum 300 seconds. Set higher if experiencing rate limiting.

parameter.name: apiKey
parameter.label: API Key
parameter.description: API Key for authenticated Octopus GraphQL account data (optional for public Agile forecast only).

parameter.name: accountNumber
parameter.label: Account Number
parameter.description: Your Octopus Energy account number (optional for public Agile forecast only).

parameter.name: agileProductCode
parameter.label: Agile Product Code
parameter.description: Optional Agile import product code (for example AGILE-24-10-01). Leave blank to auto-select latest active Agile import product.

parameter.name: agileExportProductCode
parameter.label: Agile Export Product Code
parameter.description: Optional Agile OUTGOING (export) product code (for example AGILE-OUTGOING-24-10-01). Leave blank to auto-select latest active Agile OUTGOING product.

parameter.name: agileRegion
parameter.label: Agile Region
parameter.description: Region code for the Agile tariff endpoint. Leave blank to auto-detect from your account tariff (requires API Key and Account Number).
